targets.authors: Caruso, E. M., Gilbert, D. T., & Wilson, T. D.
targets.title: A Wrinkle in Time - Asymmetric Valuation of Past and Future Events.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted very close replications of three experiments derived from two influential TVA papers: Studies 1 and 4 in Caruso et al. (2008), demonstrating TVA in monetary valuation, and Study 1 in Caruso (2010), demonstrating TVA in moral judgment.
targets.outcome_quote: We failed to find support for TVA in monetary valuation (Caruso et al., 2008).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict for the central TVA findings.

targets.title: When the Future Feels Worse than the Past: A Temporal Inconsistency in Moral Judgment.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted very close replications of three experiments derived from two influential TVA papers: Studies 1 and 4 in Caruso et al. (2008), demonstrating TVA in monetary valuation, and Study 1 in Caruso (2010), demonstrating TVA in moral judgment.
targets.outcome_quote: We also failed to find support for TVA in moral judgments (Caruso, 2010) and in our conceptual extension.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict for this target; conceptual extension also failed.

reasoning: Two published target papers tested with newly recruited participants. References copied as printed; the 2010 reference prints an apparently anomalous DOI, retained verbatim. Supplementary material follows the complete main article and reference list.
